title.rendered: Clean Up Mixed Paper with Laser Object Detection!

content.rendered:
New LOD technology on optical sorters can see objects that NIR cannot, like black plastics and random trash items.

See a demonstration of Laser Object Detection (LOD) technology, which automatically ejects contaminants like black plastic and mixed paper.
